audience: nonprofit fundraisers who collect online donations with GivingFuel

useCases.title: Add up donations by form
useCases.text: The AI lists donation orders or transactions by form and date range, with totals and status. It sums them up so you see which forms raised the most.

useCases.title: Find all donations from one donor
useCases.text: The AI finds a donor by email and lists their orders and transactions, with the donor's lifetime amount.

useCases.title: Check which recurring gifts are due soon
useCases.text: The AI lists recurring donations filtered by form, status or next payment date, with amount, schedule and payments remaining.

useCases.title: Review your coupons and how often they were used
useCases.text: The AI lists coupons, account-wide or for one form, with discounts, codes, availability, redeemed count and expiry.

useCases.title: Create or delete a discount coupon
useCases.text: The AI creates a coupon with a percent or fixed discount and codes, limited to a form, a number of uses or an expiry date, or deletes one for good. Donors can use a new coupon at once.

useCases.title: Check the limited-quantity items of a form
useCases.text: The AI reads a form's inventory items with sold and remaining quantity, for example for a gala with limited seats.
